title: API: account label on categories and category groups (contract, migration, handlers, CLI/MCP), like the person label
description: Server half of budget-lul6. Categories and groups already carry an optional person (user_id; operations categories.set_person, categories.set_group_person). Add an optional account label the same way: a category or a group can be tagged with one account of the same budget; a category with no own label inherits its group's. Read side returns it on category and group rows. No money logic here.
notes: REVIEW (orchestrator) 2026-11-27: accepted on my side. Full api suite on branch 1725 pass/0 fail (run by me); shared helper effectiveAccountId/effectivePersonId added in cd565f5.
acceptance_criteria: Contract + handler + store + migration (additive) + tests; account must belong to the same budget and not be deleted (re-scoped by budget_id in SQL), clearing with null works; deleting/closing an account leaves labels readable or clears them (decide, document, test); access.test.ts and catalog-outputs.test.ts samples added; export/restore round-trips the label; typecheck, lint, full api + shared tests green.
